title: Functions: topic test
description: A 25-minute test on functions: 13 questions, 20 marks, from quick questions to longer answers. Questions are drawn at random from the question bank, so every attempt is different.
instructions:
Answer every question. You have 25 minutes.

- Multiple-choice, true/false, matching, gap-fill, numerical and most short answers are marked automatically when you submit.
- Written answers cannot be marked automatically: after you submit, each one is shown with our mark scheme so that you can mark your own answer honestly.

sections.title: Section A: short questions
sections.instructions: Each question is worth 1 mark.

sections.title: Section B: longer questions
sections.instructions: These questions are worth 2 and 7 marks. Use the marks as a guide to how much to write.
